snippet.title: Luck be a Landlord - Coming to Consoles on February 6th
snippet.description:
Luck be a Landlord is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S, and Xbox Series X on February 6th!

Luck be a Landlord is a roguelike deckbuilder about using a slot machine to earn rent money and defeat capitalism. This game does not contain any real-world currency gambling or microtransactions.

https://LuckBeALandlord.com/
https://TrampolineTales.com/
